rdfs:label: insertedContentRelation
rdfs:comment: On an LDP container, the predicate the server uses to find the actual member inside the POSTed content; the default `ldp:MemberSubject` means the new resource itself is the member.
notes: Required on IndirectContainers; Basic/Direct containers behave as if it were ldp:MemberSubject (`urn:solid:MemberSubject`), the default meaning "the new resource itself is the member". On an IndirectContainer it tells the server: "when a resource is POSTed, look up the value of *this* predicate inside it, and use *that* as the actual member." Example pattern: a friends container using `foaf:primaryTopic` so the member is the person a POSTed document describes, not the document itself.

history.note: Dropped IndirectContainer domain; notes mention MemberSubject default; example uses foaf:knows/primaryTopic instead of nonexistent schema:likedBy.
